SPEC CORRECTION 2 (s8). The spec's local command 'podman build -f profiles/Dockerfile -t badtakes-profiles .' fails: <dockerfile>.dockerignore discovery is a BuildKit feature, podman/buildah does not look for it and falls back to the root .dockerignore (the render image's deny-all, which excludes profiles/), so the build dies at the first COPY with 'no items matching glob ".../profiles/package.json" (1 filtered out using .../.dockerignore)' - which reads like a missing file and is a missing ignore file. podman needs '--ignorefile profiles/Dockerfile.dockerignore'; docker build on ubuntu-latest is BuildKit and discovers it. Spec s8 rewritten with the working command and the reason; the same note is in the Dockerfile and in deploy-profiles.yml's build step.

SPEC CORRECTION 3 (s2). Two answers the routing table did not name, now written into the spec: a database failure on a page is 500 + no-store, never a 404 (a cached 404 would read as mass deletion for a minute after an outage ended), and /status answers 503 {"db":false} rather than 200 with a false flag.
